scenario: Approve a draft whose body contains composed Unicode. Submit the visually identical decomposed body first, then retry the exact approved body.
expected_receipt_effects: No receipt for the normalized substitute.
One receipt for the exact approved bytes after the legitimate retry.

scenario: Assign a reviewer to the clinic-a record. Provision another clinic with the same case identifier and recipient label. Attempt to use the valid clinic-a reviewer credential to approve the clinic-b proposal.
expected_receipt_effects: The foreign clinic receives no receipt.
The valid clinic-a workflow still delivers once.

scenario: Approve a draft. Remove the reviewer's live patient assignment without editing the proposal or approval record, then attempt the original exact send.
Approve a draft. Attempt to create a second draft using the same proposal ID, with a different message body. Try the substituted body against the original approval before sending the original body.
expected_receipt_effects: No receipt for the substituted body.
One receipt whose digest matches the original approved body.
